title: prepare for ryuen information attack
context: Year 1 Volume 5; scene-specific competition conditions and asymmetric knowledge gates apply.
observed_actions: Identifies the roster leak early and privately chooses not to change the final lineup because he wants Suzune to discover and handle the spy; he nudges her through a harsh lesson to win Sudō back, while deliberately misrepresenting his choices to Hirata as Suzune's plan.
observed_result: Accepts immediate competitive risk to create an opportunity for Suzune's growth, predicts future class improvement despite expecting poor festival results, and chooses a personally meaningful race against Manabu.
epistemic_limits: This does not show he mechanically caused the overall last place or that an explicit fixed preference to make his class lose governs all future exams. His self-disclosed intent is to let Suzune solve the specific issue.
information_available: Only actors participating in the scene know their own actions; narrated thoughts and later private revelations never create global actor memories.
counterfactual_test: Compare against same event, equipment, rest, teammates, opponents and information, preserving injury/obstruction and luck. Unobserved counterfactual remains unknown.
